notes.title: Ghost Keeper Demo is available now!
JDM: Japanese Drift Master is now available!
notes.content:
We’ve got great news – our latest title:JDM: Japanese Drift Master, is now live on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/ 
This is a unique game born out of our deep love for cars and passion for Japanese culture.

Get ready to explore the open world of Guntama – a city full of atmospheric streets, mountain passes, and iconic, fully licensed cars. Drift through the corners, tune your vehicles, and follow Touma’s journey through a story-rich manga-style narrative. All of that wrapped in a vibrant soundtrack and a visually engaging world.

If you’re craving fresh thrills and heart-pounding driving that rewards precision – now’s the perfect time to take the wheel!

Still not sure if it’s your thing? Check out the official launch trailer below and see what JDM is all about — we think you’ll feel the rush.

[previewyoutube=-iebhqKtmcg;full][/previewyoutube]

Gaming Factory

notes.title: JDM: Rise of the Scorpion is available now!
notes.content:
Hi,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/70608a78d69c49fbfd5377c721ef23324ebe54b2.png

After months of hard work and dedication, the Gaming Factory team is thrilled to share what we've been working on. The F2P prologue to JDM: Japanese Drift Master - JDM: Rise of the Scorpion - is finally available! Dive into this standalone introduction to the world of JDM that we’ve been passionately crafting.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1364930/JDM_Rise_of_the_Scorpion/

Explore the dynamic open world where you can drift, race, and test your driving skills. Play a variety of narrative events and learn the story of Hatori Hasashi. Follow his journey to becoming the titular ‘Scorpion’. 

To hype you even more for your first playthrough, we have prepared one more exciting trailer:

[previewyoutube=LiOvNSu4A0w;full][/previewyoutube]
JDM: Japanese Drift Master is Coming This Fall!
Add the game to your Steam wishlist to stay updated on all the latest announcements and updates. The characters you meet in this unique introduction will return in the full version of the game, along with many new heroes and storylines.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/

We’re waiting for your feedback
We encourage you to fill in the survey to help us improve the full version of the game. Additionally, we invite you to share your impressions and suggestions on our Discord channel.

We would like to express a huge thank you for your support and patience. Without your passion and commitment, this project would not be possible. Thank you!

See you on the track,
Gaming Factory

notes.title: Ghost Keeper Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Foodballers,

We’re proud to announce a new title releasing in the year 2025 - Ghost Keeper. Take on the role of an acolyte tasked with scaring mortals. Inspired by the classic, Ghost Master, the upcoming game will introduce you to the grotesque world of the Victorian era.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/

Manage monsters and wraiths whose unique abilities will help you spread fear among the living. Face the ghost-hating Brotherhood, who will do anything to thwart your plans. Stay alert and devise the best tactics. You are not alone in your adventure, as a demonic partner accompanies you every step of the way. His hilarious comments add charm to the ever-present aura of horror. Look what we prepared for you in this title:

[previewyoutube=LVfs-iHNUvw;full][/previewyoutube]
Ghost Keeper combines elements known from old-school games with modern innovations and mechanics. It will work perfectly for both those familiar with retro titles and those trying the genre for the first time. 

Add the game to your wishlist on Steam and look forward to further information. Feel free to join us on Discord, where you'll experience horror and laughter, and check out our brand new Twitter / X !

notes.title: Back2School - big discounts and a bundle
notes.content:
Hello!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207905/cb1309be5ca688bafd8b13b5ab5989cd689c9826.png

Holidays are over, it's time to go back to school. After school though it's best to relax a bit and have some fun. We have prepared for you a bundle great for that and of course the discount for this game.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27707/Back2School/

Here are the games you will get in the bundle:

 Bakery Simulator
 ZooKeeper
 Bug Academy + Dlc (Artistic Kit)
 Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator
 Gallic Wars - Battle Simulator
 Commander '85
 Pangeon
 Foodtruck Arena
 Bouncy Bob: Episode 2
 Gunslingers & Zombies

 1. Bug Academy + Dlc (Artistic Kit)) where you learn Physics- How the furniture in the apartment reacts when a refrigerator enters it through the window, Mathematics - Calculating the angle account when throwing cows to the fence, and Art - Painting pictures while having fun with tossing cows and smashing everything.

2. ZooKeeper  where you learn Natural Sciences - different animal species, their reactions, and characteristics and Business Studies - the basics of ZOO, animals, and staff management while having the pleasure of watching animals and creating your own zoo

3. Bakery Simulator where you learn Cooking - Baking to be precise. You will get a basic knowledge how what the baking process looks like and you find out what kind of machines bakers use and have fun baking your favorite bread in the game and then doing it in real life! 

4. Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator where you learn Technology - many kinds of bombs that can be found nowadays, how to disarm them, and how dangerous the sapper's job can really be and have fun searching for a bomb and having the thrill of disarming it just in time.

5. Gallic Wars - Battle Simulator where you learn History - Never heard of ancient times? Romans, Gauls? Those two nations didn't like each other too much. Physics - what can happen if a catapult's stone hit a big group of units? Have fun using magic, traps, and catapults.

6. Commander '85 where you learn History - Experience what it was like in the 1980s. How some feared war and feared new technologies coming into our lives... The rise of computers Science - Find out how computers worked in the 1980s, and how hard it was to operate them compared to the present while having fun with challenging gameplay, where there are no tutorials, no help, no easy solutions. There is only you, a small monitor screen, and commands.

7. Pangeon where you learn IT - how to use only pixels, that create blurry pictures to make a game in the times of hyper-realistic graphics while having fun searching the dungeons and killing monsters.

8. Foodtruck Arena where you learn PE - In most physical challenges, good cooperation is always vital. It is not different here. Arena, football, cars, cooperation. That's quite a good combo to get a lot of fun.

9. Bouncy Bob: Episode 2 where you learn what to do on School break - how to cope with your friends when no one tells you what to do or not do!

10. Gunslingers & Zombies - Face Zombie Apocalypse in Wild West. Manage your crew in a Turn-based strategy and adventure game. Survive, scavenge, and explore the world. Use the different talents of your team members and develop your tactics. Resolve the zombie mystery.


When your mom comes in saying "stop playing, it's time to learn something" - you just need to show this.

One more thing... Check our upcoming game Electrician Simulator!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/

Good Luck and Have Fun, fellow gamers! :)

notes.title: Devlog#8 - Progress, new features, map and character
notes.content:
Greetings Foodballers!

 Lately we have updated our Demo Version on Steam! and now we want to share Full Version progress with You.

Long story short we have prepared for You so far

 8 various Foodtrucks with few skins each
 5 different maps each with unique visuals and a dedicated soundtrack
 5 different field shapes you can combine with 3 weather types (so 15 match modes)
 tournament system with world map
 story for each character presented in comic style
 challenging AI that will still surprise You even after 30+ hours of gameplay (all testers agree on that)
 Steam Remote Play multiplayer

and recently we have deployed numerous additional graphic effects, sounds and improved game physics, the game feels more smooth and bouncy now. Check match video below to see those.

We are especially proud of our Food Trucks, all of them feel individual and different. 
Fast and nimble Among, heavy tank John or well-rounded Siv. Pick Your favourite!
https://i.imgur.com/jiK9BzB.jpg
We are happy with our character balance work as well. Every Food Truck has ways to counter another and every skill can be double-edged sword so use them wisely!

At the beginning of the game, there will be 4 playable characters and a lot of stuff to unlock with Tournament progress. Micheline Star! I'm coming!
https://i.imgur.com/sAW8CiD.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/otdJAkF.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/lA9ftz9.jpg
Comic styled story adds even more spice to Tournament

And since we have mentioned various improvements its simply best to just show them in-game on the new map - the USA where John is defending his turf against Demo team... with snowballs!
[previewyoutube=xs_3W1uU74M;full][/previewyoutube]John's skill is swapping the team's goals for 5 seconds with 2 seconds channel time

Currently, we are focused on Nintendo Switch version of a game
Don't forget to share Your feedback and cool plays on our Discord Server!
Yours - Foodtruck Arena Team
PS. Few skins are shown below this nice Add to Wishlist button :)

notes.title: DevLog#3 - Skins & Controls
notes.content:
Hello, world!

Even though it’s getting warmer, we’re all behaving like responsible adults and staying at home.

That doesn’t mean that we’re not working, though!

Here’s a fresh bunch of news right from the world of Food Ball:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207905/4db36c46dc6cbbed770cc4c62c8c8af50d1cc8f5.png

If you’re bored by the good old’ flat field, we’ve got the first keyword for you: shapes! Curves and waves, we love how they not only look nice but also influence the gameplay. You’d think that food trucks are not as good off-road as 4x4; and yet, and yet...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207905/eaa0293b2e33520aeb6c2bee05b1c73f39cb94a2.png

It’s more of a subtle teaser than anything else, but… The second keyword is - skins. Do you like to mix and match the colors of your characters as much as we do? And especially when it comes to cars, where one thing is always clear: the red one is definitely faster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207905/6b3ab4f3a231dde1822fa33e24dfcbe5b177980b.png

Last but not least, keyword: controls. As much as we all love our trusty keyboards, there’s nothing better than a quick match on a gamepad. Don’t worry, Food Ball will support them, too!


Aaand, that’s a wrap!

Please, stay safe and look forward to more news from the Cat-astrophe Games team. ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207905/146e88188f5b4be831aa1eedf4130d39c2041946.png
